items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Well maybe Albert Jones or you know, or Dede.

ctx.x: Ask Saeed or Joe Roque show. Joe Roque show. And they could tell you where. Because May lived somewhere around that way. I can't remember where Saeed lived at.
Well maybe Albert Jones or you know, or Dede. That's all in that same neighborhood.
Dede must not be able to be in touch with him on the corner because he can't see so good you know. Oh no. No but I don't know if Miley Barnes knew him now.
